note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Both paths are shown exactly as supplied; no path is preferred and no conclusion is drawn.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the chain turns back. B's Art. 9 prints a reference to Art. 2 on the first page, so B's second hop crosses back over the pages to Art. 2 (placed before Art. 4); A stops at Art. 9. The changed row is still Art. 9's.
